verdict.rationale: Airweave is a data-integration/search backend that other AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) query via MCP/API — it explicitly positions itself as 'a building block for developers to set up integrations for their internal agent/agent product,' not as a product with its own built-in assistant to delegate tasks to. The user-delegation-to-built-in-assistant axis is a category mismatch for this kind of infrastructure/tool product.
